latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Roast Coach skill with two personality modes: Supportive Mentor and Savage Roaster.
- Offers configurable morning check-ins and evening reviews tailored to the chosen mode.
- Roast intensity is customizable (1–10), with safeguards to avoid actually hurtful feedback.
- Dynamic responses adjust based on user performance, with tone softening if user struggles.
- Configuration options for mode, intensity, schedule, and coach name.
- Humor focused on motivation—celebrates wins, roasts setbacks, always mixes genuine support.
